title: 67 Mini Version
blurb: Two seconds flat. The mini version of the 67 chant exists for moments when timing matters more than volume: the beat of silence after a question, the split second before a teacher regains control, the gap between a friend saying 'six' and everyone else in the call joining in. Brainrot audio tends to sprawl, so a properly trimmed cut is rarer than it should be. Keep this one loaded for rapid-fire responses. The full-length versions are for ceremony; this is for combat.
origin: A trimmed two-second cut of the 67 chant.
